title: From Shortcut to Induction Head: How Data Diversity Shapes Algorithm Selection in Transformers

layout.note: A 2-column by 3-row grid on white. Two dark-blue banners (Pretraining Data, OOD Test Data) head the columns. The rows are a plain input strip, Solution 1 (positional shortcut) and Solution 2 (induction head), whose teal titles sit at the left above the left strip. Each cell redraws a token strip with a green or red target cell, an arrow for the matching step below it, a triangle or curved arrow for the output, and a verdict word at the bottom of the OOD column.

lesson: To show that two mechanisms agree on training data and part ways out of distribution, redraw one toy token strip in a grid with data regimes as columns and mechanisms as rows, and change one cue only: a green target cell that stays correct against a red crossed cell when the gap lengths differ.
